notes.selection: nearest_component: group the features carrying the road's tigerNames into components by shared vertices, take the one nearest the origin, and fail unless it is under maxDistanceM away and contains every name in tigerNames.
notes.clip: Bounds are true metres, before any compression. Keep the whole TIGER vertices with xMinM <= x <= xMaxM. Never interpolate an end vertex, so every vertex keeps its TIGER lon/lat.
notes.mtfcc: width is paved width in metres. Widths and surfaces are assumed defaults by road class, not surveyed: TIGER records neither.
notes.overrides: Road id to {width, surface, reason}. Empty because there is no evidence for any override yet.
notes.compressionBands: One global remap of x, f: the identity west of a band, scaled by factor inside it, a constant shift east of it. trueFrom and trueTo are true metres, west to east, with no overlap. z and lon/lat never change. The build fails if a graph node or trestle is inside a band or a band edge is within 1 mm of a kept TIGER vertex, and adds a vertex wherever a kept segment crosses a band edge.

clip.basis: 500 m past the west trestle (x -4160.2) and the Meehan Savoy Rd junction (x 5807.8), rounded out to 10 m. US 80 crosses each bound once. It ends at TIGER vertices x -4663, z 183 and x 6258, z -574.

continuation.basis: TIGER's Adams St ends 870 m from US 80, short of I-20. All three names carry the same geometry from its north end to clipAt, so take that geometry once. clipAt is the road's first contact with an S1630 ramp of the I-20 interchange, 774.0 m on, and TIGER leaves no gap. The road's first shared vertex with I-20 itself is 144.4 m further north.

compressionBands.reason: US 80 between the far east trestle and Meehan-Savoy Rd: 3.84 km with no junction or trestle, over four times the camera's 900 m far plane. It still holds one river crossing, and the railroad and river run through it. Their order is kept, but bearings inside the band change.
compressionBands.basis: 150 m east of trestle-east-far (x 1072.95) and 150 m west of Meehan-Savoy Rd's minimum x (x 5213.20), to the nearest metre. The band becomes 960 m long, about one far plane. x 1220 was rejected because it's 3 mm from a river vertex: the nearest kept vertices to these edges are 0.855 m and 1.647 m away.
